title: Symbol edit mode: double-click to enter/exit symbol
description: Flash 8 allows double-clicking a symbol instance on stage to enter Edit-in-Place mode: the stage dims, the symbol's own timeline is shown in the Timeline panel, and you edit the symbol directly. Double-clicking outside or pressing Escape exits back to the parent timeline. This requires Shell.tsx to track an editPath stack (array of {symbolId, instanceId}) and a matching withSymbolTimeline helper. The stage should show parent dimmed with an onion-skin-style overlay. See docs/05-symbols-library.md § Edit in Place.
